title: Internal: Checking Account Referral Program Terms and Restrictions
summary: This document sets general terms for all Rho-Bank checking account referral programs: a rolling cap of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window (third+ auto-denied), eligibility rules for new customers, address/age/tenure restrictions, and bonus conditions (new money, 30-day retention, possible 90-day clawback on closure).
faqs: What is the rolling limit for receiving checking account referral bonuses (and what happens if I exceed it)?
Who is eligible to be referred (new customer rules, 12-month account lookback, address restriction, and age/minor exception)?
How is referrer tenure calculated and does the current checking account type matter?
What deposit requirements must the referred person meet for the referral bonus (new money, 30-day hold, and closure clawback timing)?
Can I stack referral bonuses with other promotions or use more than one referral code on a new account?
What referral statuses mean (COMPLETE, IN_PROGRESS, NO_PROGRESS, APPLIED, REJECTED, ERROR)?
keywords: New Rho-Bank customer (no checking/savings/closed accounts in past 12 months)
Referrer and referred cannot share an address
18+ (Light Green Account allows minors with guardian)
Referrer tenure threshold (earliest checking account open date)
Qualifying deposit must be new money
Clawback if account closed within 90 days
Stacking restrictions / only one referral code
